decision_policy.D: More than 36 features retained; stop before DEV_VAL scoring.
decision_policy.A: At most 36 features retained, both point deltas satisfy margins, and both bootstrap lower bounds are at or above the corresponding negative margin.
decision_policy.C: For either metric, its point delta and bootstrap upper bound are both below its negative margin, or both point metrics miss their margins.
decision_policy.B: Substantial compaction succeeds but neither A nor C applies; performance retention has a modest/uncertain tradeoff.

final_method_policy.FINAL_COMPACT: Only if Decision A, every family remains represented, reduction >= 40%, ROC point delta >= -0.005, and AP point delta >= -0.01.
final_method_policy.FINAL_FULL_48: Otherwise retain FULL_48 because it already owns confirmation evidence and COMPACT does not.

final_method_rationale: FULL_48 retains the existing strong confirmation evidence, and COMPACT did not satisfy every conservative condition required to justify replacing it.
paper_interpretation: Correlation redundancy did not imply safe predictive removability: the deterministic compact representation materially degraded discrimination.
